user.title: Add alarm endpoint
user.description: Pair an Assist satellite with the media player that should ring alarms in that room. Scheduler Component must already be installed and configured.

data_description.name: A friendly room/endpoint name, such as Bedroom.
data_description.area_id: Optional Home Assistant area for this endpoint.
data_description.assist_satellite_entity_id: The Assist satellite that receives voice commands in this room.
data_description.media_player_entity_id: The media player that will play this room's alarms.

error.scheduler_not_ready: Scheduler Component is not ready. Install it, add the Scheduler integration, and make sure its scheduler.add/edit/remove actions are available.
error.entity_not_found: The selected entity is not currently available.

abort.already_configured: This Assist satellite is already configured as a Satellite Alarms endpoint.

init.title: Alarm defaults
init.description: Configure playback, snooze, volume, and timeout defaults for this alarm endpoint.

data_description.default_volume: Volume from 0.0 to 1.0 used when an alarm rings.
data_description.default_snooze_minutes: Minutes used when the user says Snooze without specifying a duration.
data_description.volume_ramp_enabled: Gradually increase volume when alarms begin ringing.
data_description.volume_ramp_start: Starting volume for the gradual wake ramp.
data_description.volume_ramp_seconds: How long the volume ramp should take.
data_description.max_ring_minutes: Stop an unanswered alarm after this many minutes.
data_description.default_alarm_media: Optional media URL or Home Assistant media reference. When set, the alarm repeats this media through assist_satellite.announce.
data_description.default_alarm_message: Spoken fallback used when no alarm media is configured.
